PDF Page Cropper

Trim PDF margins: set crop margins in inches per edge on all pages or a page range, with a live margin preview in your browser.

PDF Page Cropper

Trim margins by setting the PDF crop box — content is hidden, not deleted.

Margin preview

Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Upload a PDF.
  2. Enter margin sizes in inches for top, right, bottom and left.
  3. Optionally limit cropping to a page range (e.g. 1-3,5).
  4. Click "Crop & Download" to save.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Does cropping delete the content?

It sets the PDF crop box — the content outside your margins is hidden from view and print, but the original data stays in the file.

Can I crop only some pages?

Enter ranges like 1-3,5 or leave the field empty for all pages.

Are my files uploaded anywhere?

Everything is processed locally in your browser with PDF-Lib. Your files are never uploaded to any server.
